items.name: viya4-iac-azure
items.description: This project contains Terraform configuration files to provision infrastructure components required to deploy SAS Viya platform products on Microsoft Azure Cloud.

items.name: viya4-deployment
items.description: This project contains Ansible code that creates a baseline in an existing Kubernetes environment for use with the SAS Viya Platform, generates the manifest for an order, and then can also deploy that order into the Kubernetes environment specified.

items.name: sas-viya-programming
items.description: Code samples and materials to help you learn to access SAS Viya services by writing programs in Python and other open-source languages.

items.name: sas-viya-quick-start
items.description: This repository provides the files referenced in the SAS Viya Quick Start Videos. Files can be loaded into your SAS Viya platform to follow along with the videos.

items.name: viya4-iac-aws
items.description: This project contains Terraform configuration files to provision infrastructure components required to deploy SAS Viya platform products products on Amazon AWS.

items.name: viya4-monitoring-kubernetes
items.description: Provides simple scripts and customization options to deploy monitoring, alerts, and log aggregation for Viya 4 running on Kubernetes

items.name: viya-ark
items.description: SAS Viya Administration Resource Kit  (SAS Viya ARK). Tools and utilities to help SAS customers with SAS Viya readiness.

items.name: saspy
items.description: A Python interface module to the SAS System. It works with Linux, Windows, and Mainframe SAS as well as with SAS in Viya.

items.name: viya4-iac-k8s
items.description: This project contains Terraform scripts to provision cloud infrastructure resources, when using vSphere or bare-metal, and Ansible to apply the needed elements of a Kubernetes cluster that are required to deploy SAS Viya platform product offerings.

items.name: viya4-iac-gcp
items.description: This project contains Terraform configuration files to provision infrastructure components required to deploy SAS Viya platform products on Google Cloud

items.name: viya4-ark
items.description: SAS Viya Administration Resource Kit for Containerized Deployments. Tools and utilities to help SAS Customers with SAS Viya running in containers.

items.name: sas-viya-dmml-pipelines
items.description: Code examples and supporting materials for data mining and machine learning techniques on the SAS Viya environment.

items.name: python-sasctl
items.description: Python package and CLI for user-friendly integration with SAS Viya

items.name: viya4-admin-checklist
items.description: This project contains tasks that are relevant to your environment, to keep your SAS Viya deployment operating at its best over the long term.

items.name: pyviyatools
items.description: Python command-line tools that call the SAS Viya REST APIs - for SAS administrators.
